newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Aug wholesale price index down 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Aug wholesale price index down 0.4 pct.

text.p: Morocco's wholesale price index dropped 0.4 percent in August to 359.6 from 360.9 in the previous month, the Statistics Directorate said.
The average index for the first eight months of the year rose 6.1 percent compared with the same period in 1995.
The fall came essentially from a drop of 1.0 percent in farm products while the industrial sector prices rose 0.1 percent, it said.
